text:
ryan: hey team, quick question — I got access to Slack and my laptop but my VPN keeps disconnecting every 10-15 min. do i file here or DM IT? also, where do i post if i need access to cloud projects?

onboarding-bot: Welcome Ryan! Please follow the checklist in #onboarding-resources and run `setup check` in the CLI tool. If you want fewer reminders, DM @onboarding-bot with `preferences notify off` to reduce pings.
sophie: hey — VPN is IT. DM @it-support or `/ticket create` if you want tracking. Cloud project access: make a PR to the access repo (instructions in #dev-access) or tag @sophie for faster review.

archie: also: for "which channel" cheat-sheet — public infra/questions -> #eng-infra, access & onboarding -> #new-hires, security alerts -> #eng-security, team ops -> #eng. If it's personal device stuff use #help (non-sensitive) or DM IT.

it-support: if your VPN is unstable send us the logs: 
```
{
  "client": "ryan-mbp",
  "os": "macOS 12.4",
  "last_error": "auth timeout"
}
```
and run `vpn diag --collect` then attach to the ticket. Typical turnaround: 1-3 hours.

ryan: thanks! one more: do we post onboarding questions in #new-hires thread or create separate threads per question? want to avoid spamming the channel.
sophie: short onboarding Qs are fine inline. If it's a deep thread or long back-and-forth, start a new thread and mention @onboarding-bot or the person who owns the process. Also avoid posting screenshots of tokens/secrets — always redact or use secure support ticket.

onboarding-bot: Pro tip: use `@onboarding-bot remind me in 2d` to schedule follow-ups.

ryan: perfect. posting to #introductions now (timezone: PST, role: infra eng). appreciate the help :thumbsup:
